pub fn parent_with_digest<H: Digest32>(hash: H, children: &[Digest; 8]) -> Digest {
    hash.digest(&[
        &[0x18],
        &children[0],
        &children[1],
        &children[2],
        &children[3],
        &children[4],
        &children[5],
        &children[6],
        &children[7],
    ])
}
